evaluation_domains: paired valid full shared model domain
paired valid within250m of union of P1/P2/P3 terrain paths
model_footprint: max over available stored depth outputs h>=0.1m, nearest reproject to optical10m grid; preserves20/30s sampling and60/120m native model resolution
comparison_role: Exploratory retrospective spatial agreement, not calibration, independent validation, causality or a scored accuracy benchmark
one_dimensional_excluded: Equivalent constant width has no uniquely observed lateral footprint; do not rasterize it as real inundation
all_completed_2d_models: Retain unqualified reduced outputs with flag, native failures separately; do not select by best agreement
